The '''Outer Rim Imperial Fleet''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Description==
It consisted of dozens of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and at least three [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruisers]], the latter supplied by [[Imperial Drydock IV]].<ref name="Xwing" /> The most powerful element of the fleet was [[Scourge Squadron]]: a task force of 24 ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers led by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Reaper (Executor-class)|''Reaper'']].<ref name="TEGTW" />

The Outer Rim fleet was led by the [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of [[Oversector Outer]]: [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] until [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and later [[Ardus Kaine]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==History==
The fleet was probably created from the [[Eighteenth Army|18th Sector Army]], when the [[Greater Seswenna/Legends|Greater Seswenna]] was reorganized in Oversector Outer.<ref name="TEGTW" />

The Outer Rim fleet fragmented when Grand Moff Kaine turned [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and ordered Scourge Squadron to regroup in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] to join the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. The disappareance of Scourge Squadron in Oversector Outer contributed to the quick progression of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic fleet]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
